correctness.rationale: Step 1 establishes the no-zero source case. Steps 2–3 prove quotient diagonal images are abelian group components with zero cross-products, and commutativity annihilates all off-diagonal images. Step 4 gives an injective homomorphism using distinct auxiliary indices and sufficiently many group labels. Step 5 proves zero preservation and exact index lower bounds from distinct diagonal identities and the endpoints of an offdiagonal nil element. Trivial boundary cases are explicit. value.rationale: Problem 1.2(1) of arXiv:2604.04763 motivates characterization of finite Brandt divisors. The theorem gives a complete intrinsic solution for the natural commutative subclass, including infinitely many types with arbitrarily many abelian components and nil-annihilator points. The exact minimal matrix index is a sharp resource invariant, and the quotient-to-embedding collapse is a genuine structural statement rather than a routine small example.
